root_idea.summary: The root is centered on the number six and on division into six equal parts.
root_idea.development: From this numerical base develop the sixth position and sixth share, sixfold dimensions and measures, the sixth-day watering interval of camels, and the tooth cast after the fourth tooth.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed as the normalized ordinal citation form سَادِسٌ.
Displayed as the normalized fractional citation form سُدُسٌ.

senses.definition: The sixth member of a counted group; occupying position six.
senses.usage_conditions: Quranically used in the possessive construction سَادِسُهُمْ, “the sixth of them.”

senses.definition: One sixth; a sixth part of a whole.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrences, it denotes a prescribed sixth share in inheritance contexts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take a sixth share of people’s possessions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I verb; used transitively with the people or property from which the share is taken.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become the sixth among a group, or to make a group or number six by joining it oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I numerical usage; the same pattern may describe increasing a counted group by one, such as making fifty-nine sixty or fifteen sixteen.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something six in number.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II causative numerical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make six-cornered, six-angled, hexagonal, or six-ribbed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II usage describing the resulting sixfold shape or structure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remain six nights with one’s wife; by extension, to perform an act or say something six times.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional Form II temporal or repetitive construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a party to become six in number; in one numerical extension, to become sixty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV usage with a collective subject.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a camel, sheep, or goat, to cast the tooth called the سَدِيس, after the رَبَاعِيَة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The casting is normally associated with the eighth year; a sheep or goat may also be described as six years old in this connection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For camels to come to water on the sixth day of their watering cycle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reckoning varies in the cited descriptions, but counts the preceding watering day as the first or describes five intervening days without water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Six, as an archaic or original form of سِتّ, the feminine of سِتَّة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A historical or variant cardinal form, with the plural أَسْدَاسٌ reported in the lexical discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sixth young one or offspring.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Nominal usage referring to birth or offspring order.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Six and six together, or six at a time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A very rare reported usage; the source explicitly notes that it may not actually have been heard.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A ṭaylasān-type cloak; more broadly, a garment of the color called خُضْرَة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal garment or garment-color designation, with variant vocalization سَدُوسٌ also reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Smoke-black material from fat or lamp-black pigment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A color or pigment designation, identified with نِيلَنْجٌ in the cited discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The tooth after the رَبَاعِيَة and before the بَازِل.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A masculine or feminine anatomical term for the relevant tooth; plural forms are also reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel, sheep, or goat casting its سَدِيس tooth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The animal is generally in its eighth year; a sheep or goat may also be described as six years old.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A type of measure, or a kind of مَكُّوك, used for measuring dates.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete measure designation rather than a general numerical ordinal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In لا آتِيكَ سَدِيسَ عُجَيْسٍ, a dialectal form related to سَجِيسَ and conveying “ever”; with negation, “never.”
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Restricted to the cited idiomatic expression and its negative construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Six cubits in length, especially of an إِزَار garment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective of measured length applied to the specified garment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Six spans in height, applied to a slave.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited lexical usage specifically applies the adjective to a slave’s height.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A word composed of six letters, whether radicals alone or radicals with augmentative letters.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical description of word form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sixteenth in the compound ordinal سَادِسَ عَشَرَ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A compositional ordinal construction with the corresponding feminine form سَادِسَةَ عَشْرَةَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Composed of six layers, strata, or distinct sections; also hexagonal or a hexagon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II passive participial adjective or noun describing sixfold composition or shape.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A verse composed of six metrical feet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Technical poetic usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rope composed of six strands.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial descriptive noun for six-stranded construction.

cautions: The reported سُدَاسَ sense is explicitly marked as possibly unattested and should be treated as marginal.
The Quranic ordinal is normalized to سَادِسٌ and the fractional form to سُدُسٌ; the supplied Quran occurrences are inflected or definite surface forms.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: The Mufradat mention of سندس and الإستبرق, and the Lane pointer to سندس, are not assigned to this root artifact because they are distinct lexical identities and the packet supplies no direct evidence establishing them as forms of canonical root سدس.
